_source: Generated with segno 1.6.6, an independent ISO/IEC 18004-conformant implementation, via the recipe in __tests__/fixtures/README.md. Each entry is the exact module matrix segno produces for that segmentation, version, level and mask.
_segments: Every case pins its segmentation explicitly. Two encoders can both be correct and still split a string differently across modes, so comparing module matrices only means something when both are given the same segments. Our own mode selection is checked separately, by asserting it is never larger than a single-mode encoding.
_excluded: Cases whose bit stream is already byte-aligned after the terminator are absent. segno adds a spurious zero byte there - write_padding_bits uses 8 - length % 8 rather than (8 - length % 8) % 8 - which also affects its full-QR output. ISO/IEC 18004 7.4.10, quoted in segno's own docstring for that function, adds padding bits only when the stream does not end at a codeword boundary. Detected with segno's own primitives rather than a hardcoded list; our encoder covers the same path with a round trip instead. Skipped: alphanumeric[HELLO]+numeric[123] M4-L; alphanumeric[HELLO]+numeric[123] M4-M; alphanumeric[HELLO]+numeric[123] M4-Q; numeric[12]+alphanumeric[AB] M2-L
